hook: Your old 2 rupee note had a satellite on the back.
title: Your 2 Rupee Note Carried a Satellite
description:
India's first satellite, Aryabhata, launched in 1975. It was printed on the back of the 2 rupee note. Check an old note and you can see it yourself.

#Shorts #ISRO #Aryabhata
comment_prompt: Ever held one of these notes? Yes or no

scenes.narration: Your old 2 rupee note had a satellite on the back.
scenes.headline: A SATELLITE ON MONEY

scenes.narration: That satellite is Aryabhata, India's very first.
scenes.headline: ARYABHATA

scenes.narration: It launched in 1975, from a Soviet rocket.
scenes.headline: LAUNCHED 1975

scenes.narration: India built the satellite itself, at ISRO.
scenes.headline: BUILT IN INDIA

scenes.narration: Then it was printed on everyday pocket money.
scenes.headline: PRINTED ON CASH

scenes.narration: Millions of people held a satellite without knowing.
scenes.headline: IN YOUR HAND

scenes.narration: Check your old notes. It might still be there.
scenes.headline: CHECK YOUR NOTES

scenes.narration: Tomorrow: ISRO rocket parts carried by bicycle.
scenes.headline: NEXT: ROCKET ON A BIKE
